scope: only R9 section ①; T4 and final review belong to independent Codex
test_key_recovery: select final12 calendar keys per declared CSV, preserving original order, then REQUIRE exact prior ordered key hash BEFORE any dynamic history decode. If mismatch, stop. No use of target missingness.
T2_cohort: 81 wells/972 rows; exact original label-key-order hash
ALIGN_MATCH: unique k_start and k_end modes equal across train/test, and at least8/10 testwells jointly match both modes; report marginal counts as well
mode_tie_policy: no arbitrary tie selection; record unresolved modes; P3 requires unique test k_start mode
P1: exact M-1 RCYL repeated12, no fill or nearest-observation substitution
P2: exact M RCYL repeated12, current target M+1..M+12
P3_trigger: only ALIGN_MATCH=false; no unconditional extra baseline
P3_redefined_P1_literal: target_start-1 on same new target, identical by R9 literal wording; delta0 if computable; disclose ambiguity, do not create a potentially future-looking M-1 control on shifted targets
missing_predictor_policy: primary81well score UNKNOWN if any missing/nonfinite/negative, separately valid-subset descriptive only, no imputation
metric: epsilon1e-6, unnormalized2^-t, no factor2, each well then equal mean
